subject.title: fix(gateway): recover when suppressed channel secrets are unavailable

question: Should `secrets.reload` in crash-loop safe mode automatically restart accounts that were running, or must all channel starts remain explicit until safe mode clears?
rationale: Current main and the breaker-introducing commit define strict no-automatic-restart recovery, while this PR changes that operator contract to solve a startup defect that can be fixed at the source/assignment projection boundary.

options.title: Preserve strict safe mode
options.body: Keep `secrets.reload` from automatically restarting channels and narrow the fix to startup SecretRef source/assignment projection.

options.title: Adopt transactional reload restarts
options.body: Approve account-aware stop, rollback, and restart behavior as the new safe-mode contract, with exact-head supervised proof and documentation.

recommendation.title: Preserve strict safe mode
recommendation.body: Keep `secrets.reload` from automatically restarting channels and narrow the fix to startup SecretRef source/assignment projection.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the persisted breaker and the exact safe-mode reload semantics now under reconsideration.
